What's new in 0.1.67:
• New Home screen artwork for a brand-new, empty library (real Beebo-owned sample art instead of a blank placeholder).
• Choosing a Home layout (Focus & Queue, Studio Canvas, Command Deck, High-Impact Theater) is now one compact menu.
• New storybook art: 15 storybooks now have hand-illustrated cartoon scenes.
• Fixed the away-from-home Connection route screen sometimes showing the wrong answer after a fallback to Beebo Relay mid-stream.
• Fixed video conversion: a build briefly published earlier today was missing its conversion component entirely (no transcoding, no Live TV, no HDR). This build has it properly included — please update again if you installed that one.
